# Enis Qetaj (Nisigma)

> Enis Qetaj, known online as Nisigma (@N1sigma), founded Malera Studio in Kosovo. He builds websites, applications and AI automations and researches financial markets using on-chain data.

## Profile

- [About Enis Qetaj](https://enisqetaj.com/about): Biography, project examples and profile links.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/nisigma1): Public repositories.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/enis-qetaj/): Professional profile.
- [X](https://x.com/N1sigma): Market commentary as @N1sigma.

## Projects and research

- [Barber Brothers](https://enisqetaj.com/work/barber-brothers): Malera Studio's online booking project, with a [public booking page](https://barberbrothers.style/booking).
- [Malera POS at DUO Bar](https://enisqetaj.com/work/duo-bar): Offline point-of-sale software with table and order management, documented with photos.
- [Nisigma OnChain](https://enisqetaj.com/research/nisigma-onchain): How Enis Qetaj uses his public [CryptoQuant dashboard](https://cryptoquant.com/community/dashboard/682b36d9f5db9e6f926617c2).
